title: nan
authors: Candan F.; Sanci M.E.; Li L.
key_contribution: Presents a vision-based relative navigation algorithm for leader-follower UAV swarming control in GPS-denied zones, validated in Webots simulation experiments.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
